name: SharedDatabase
summary: Integrates applications by having them read and write one schema, so that there is no data to transfer and nothing to fall out of step.

roles.name: SharedDatabase
roles.summary: The participant that reads or writes the shared schema. Consistency comes free because there is one copy; what it costs is that the schema becomes a contract between applications that must agree on it, and a change to it is a change to all of them.
